mainEntity.name: What are the common myths about strength training for women?

acceptedAnswer.text: A common myth is that strength training will make women 'bulky.' This is generally untrue, as women typically have lower levels of testosterone, making significant muscle hypertrophy difficult without specific training and dietary interventions. Another myth is that cardio is superior for fat loss. In reality, strength training is highly effective for fat loss and body shaping. Our programs at Cave Training are designed to help women build lean muscle, increase strength, and improve body composition without fear of unwanted bulk.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common myths include that strength training makes women 'bulky' (unlikely due to lower testosterone) or that cardio is better for fat loss; strength training is effective for fat loss and shaping.
